summary: {{confirmed}} confirmed, {{probable}} probable and {{review}} to review ({{scanned}} definitions read).
outside: Only what is in the database is visible: applications, reports and external scripts that use it do not appear here.
unreadable: The definition of {{names}} could not be read. Whatever depends on the object there is not in the list.
none: Nothing in the database depends on this object.

confidenceTip.confirmed: The engine's catalog records the dependency.
confidenceTip.probable: The object's code names the object (and the column, with its table).
confidenceTip.review: The name appears inside a text, probably dynamic SQL: you have to read it to know whether it uses it.
